-- Kontak dan efek rintangan divalidasi server; tidak menerima laporan klien.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local H={effects={},elapsed=0}
local C,W,D,puddle,barrier,basePosition,previousPosition
local function horizontal(v) return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z) end
function H.Clear(player)
	local effect=H.effects[player.UserId]
	if effect then effect.velocity:Destroy(); effect.attachment:Destroy(); H.effects[player.UserId]=nil end
end
local function push(player,direction,speed,duration)
	local char=player.Character
	local r=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not r then return end
	H.Clear(player)
	direction=horizontal(direction)
	if direction.Magnitude<0.01 then direction=Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
	direction=direction.Unit
	local a=Instance.new("Attachment")
	a.Name="PaketKilatHazardAttachment"
	a.Parent=r
	local v=Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	v.Name="PaketKilatHazardVelocity"
	v.Attachment0=a
	v.RelativeTo=Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	v.VelocityConstraintMode=Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane
	v.PrimaryTangentAxis=Vector3.new(1,0,0)
	v.SecondaryTangentAxis=Vector3.new(0,0,1)
	v.PlaneVelocity=Vector2.new(direction.X*speed,direction.Z*speed)
	v.ForceLimitsEnabled=true
	v.ForceLimitMode=Enum.ForceLimitMode.Magnitude
	v.MaxForce=C.Hazards.MaxForce
	v.Parent=r
	H.effects[player.UserId]={velocity=v,attachment=a,expires=os.clock()+duration,root=r}
end
local function inBox(position,center,size,margin)
	local d=position-center
	return math.abs(d.X)<=size.X/2+margin and math.abs(d.Y)<=size.Y/2+margin and math.abs(d.Z)<=size.Z/2+margin
end
function H.Init(config,world,delivery)
	C,W,D=config,world,delivery
	puddle=W.Map.Expansion.Hazards.Puddle
	barrier=W.Map.Expansion.Hazards.MovingBarrier
	basePosition=barrier.Position
	previousPosition=barrier.Position
end
function H.Start()
	local sampled=0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		H.elapsed+=dt
		local omega=2*math.pi/C.Hazards.BarrierPeriod
		local pos=basePosition+Vector3.new(C.Hazards.BarrierAmplitude*math.sin(H.elapsed*omega),0,0)
		local speed=C.Hazards.BarrierAmplitude*omega*math.cos(H.elapsed*omega)
		barrier.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos)
		barrier:SetAttribute("MotionSpeed",speed)
		for userId,effect in pairs(H.effects) do
			if os.clock()>=effect.expires or not effect.root.Parent then
				effect.velocity:Destroy(); effect.attachment:Destroy(); H.effects[userId]=nil
			end
		end
		sampled+=dt
		if sampled<C.Hazards.SampleInterval then return end
		sampled=0
		local middle=(pos+previousPosition)/2
		local swept=barrier.Size+Vector3.new(math.abs(pos.X-previousPosition.X),0,0)
		for _,o in pairs(D.orders) do
			if o.outOfBounds or o.completionLocked then continue end
			o.hazardCooldowns=o.hazardCooldowns or {}
			local player=o.player
			local char=player.Character
			local r=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not r or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then continue end
			if o.status=="Carrying" then
				local localPos=puddle.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(r.Position)
				local inPuddle=math.abs(localPos.X)<=puddle.Size.X/2 and math.abs(localPos.Z)<=puddle.Size.Z/2
					and localPos.Y>=1 and localPos.Y<=5.5
					and horizontal(r.AssemblyLinearVelocity).Magnitude>=C.Hazards.SlipMinimumSpeed
				o.slipSamples=inPuddle and ((o.slipSamples or 0)+1) or 0
				if o.slipSamples>=C.Hazards.SlipSamples and os.clock()-(o.hazardCooldowns.Slip or -math.huge)>=C.Hazards.SlipCooldown then
					local direction=horizontal(r.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
					if D.Impact(o,"Slip") then
						o.hazardCooldowns.Slip=os.clock()
						push(player,direction,C.Hazards.SlipSpeed,C.Hazards.SlipDuration)
					end
				end
			else o.slipSamples=0 end
			local subject=o.status=="Carrying" and r or o.package
			if subject and subject.Parent and math.abs(speed)>=C.Hazards.BarrierMinimumSpeed
				and inBox(subject.Position,middle,swept,1.25)
				and os.clock()-(o.hazardCooldowns.Barrier or -math.huge)>=C.Hazards.BarrierCooldown then
				local wasCarrying=o.status=="Carrying"
				if D.Impact(o,"Barrier") then
					o.hazardCooldowns.Barrier=os.clock()
					if wasCarrying then push(player,Vector3.new(speed,0,0),C.Hazards.KnockbackSpeed,C.Hazards.KnockbackDuration) end
				end
			end
		end
		previousPosition=pos
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(H.Clear)
end
return H

-- Semua parameter gameplay tahap pertama. Tidak memerlukan layanan daring.
return table.freeze({
	ActionDistance = 12,
	RequestCooldown = 0.2,
	RecoveryCooldown = 5,
	InitialCondition = 100,
	ImpactDamage = 10,
	DamageCooldown = 1,
	RecoveryPenalty = 20,
	RecoveryPlayerOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
	ImpactSpeed = 55,
	ContactMargin = 0.8,
	PhysicsSampleInterval = 1 / 30,
	PackageSize = Vector3.new(2.5, 2, 2),
	CarryOffset = CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.5),
	DropOffset = CFrame.new(0, 0, -4),
	BoundsMin = Vector3.new(-24, -14, -55),
	BoundsMax = Vector3.new(124, 96, 24),
	DestinationId = "Rumah01",
	DestinationName = "Rumah Bu Sari",
	PackageType = "Biasa",
	PromptHoldDuration = 0.15,
	Labels = table.freeze({
		Start = "Ambil pesanan", Pickup = "Ambil ulang", Drop = "Lepas", Recover = "Pulihkan",
	}),
})

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local P = {}
local C, W, D, template
function P.Init(config, world, delivery, packageTemplate)
	C, W, D, template = config, world, delivery, packageTemplate
end
function P.Update(o)
	local p = o.package
	if not p then return end
	for _,key in ipairs({"orderId", "ownerUserId", "status", "condition", "outOfBounds"}) do p:SetAttribute(key, o[key]) end
	p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(183, 113 + math.floor(o.condition / 3), 64)
	p.Label.TextLabel.Text = string.format("%s · %s\n%s · %d/100%s", o.player.DisplayName, C.DestinationName, o.status, o.condition, o.outOfBounds and " · R: Pulihkan" or "")
	p.PickupPrompt.Enabled = o.status == "Dropped" and not o.outOfBounds
end
function P.Create(o)
	local p = template:Clone()
	p.Name = o.orderId
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(W.Map.Depot.PickupPoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	p.Parent = W.ActivePackages
	o.package = p
	o.promptConnection = p.PickupPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local ok, code = D.Handle(player, "Pickup", o.orderId)
		if not ok then D.Publish(player, code) end
	end)
end
local function unweld(o)
	if o.weld then o.weld:Destroy(); o.weld = nil end
end
local function resetSample(o)
	o.previousPosition, o.previousVelocity = nil, nil
end
function P.Carry(o, r)
	unweld(o)
	local p = o.package
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.Massless = false, false, true
	p.CollisionGroup = "PKCarried"
	p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	p.CFrame = r.CFrame * C.CarryOffset
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = "CarryWeld", r, p, p
	o.weld = weld
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Drop(o, r)
	unweld(o)
	local p = o.package
	p.Anchored, p.Massless, p.CanCollide = false, false, true
	p.CollisionGroup = "PKDropped"
	if r then
		local desired = r.CFrame * C.DropOffset
		-- Jangan menaruh paket di balik dinding ketika dilepas.
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {o.player.Character, W.ActivePackages}
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(r.Position, desired.Position - r.Position, params)
		p.CFrame = hit and CFrame.new(hit.Position - (desired.Position - r.Position).Unit * 2) or desired
	end
	p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	p:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Hold(o)
	unweld(o)
	o.package.AssemblyLinearVelocity, o.package.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	o.package.Anchored = true
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Recover(o)
	P.Drop(o, nil)
	o.package.CFrame = CFrame.new(W.Map.RecoveryPoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, C.PackageSize.Y / 2 + 0.4, 0))
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Destroy(o)
	if o.promptConnection then o.promptConnection:Disconnect() end
	unweld(o)
	if o.package then o.package:Destroy() end
end
function P.Start()
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < C.PhysicsSampleInterval then return end
		elapsed = 0
		local excluded = {W.ActivePackages}
		for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player.Character then table.insert(excluded, player.Character) end end
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
		params.RespectCanCollide = true
		for _,o in pairs(D.orders) do
			local p = o.package
			if not p or not p.Parent or o.outOfBounds then continue end
			local pos = p.Position - W.Map.DepotPad.Position
			local lo, hi = C.BoundsMin, C.BoundsMax
			if pos.X < lo.X or pos.Y < lo.Y or pos.Z < lo.Z or pos.X > hi.X or pos.Y > hi.Y or pos.Z > hi.Z then
				D.OutOfBounds(o)
				continue
			end
			local subject, radius = p, p.Size.Y / 2
			if o.status == "Carrying" then
				local char = o.player.Character
				subject = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if subject and hum then radius = hum.HipHeight + subject.Size.Y / 2 end
			end
			if not subject then continue end
			local current, velocity = subject.Position, subject.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			if o.previousPosition and o.previousVelocity then
				local previous = o.previousVelocity
				local speed = o.status == "Carrying" and math.max(0, -previous.Y) or previous.Magnitude
				if speed >= C.ImpactSpeed then
					local delta = current - o.previousPosition
					local hit = delta.Magnitude > 0.01 and workspace:Raycast(o.previousPosition, delta + delta.Unit * (radius + C.ContactMargin), params)
					local direction = o.status == "Carrying" and Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) or previous.Unit
					hit = hit or workspace:Raycast(current, direction * (radius + C.ContactMargin), params)
					if hit and -previous:Dot(hit.Normal) >= C.ImpactSpeed then
						D.Impact(o)
					end
				end
			end
			o.previousPosition, o.previousVelocity = current, velocity
		end
	end)
end
return P

-- Koin, jadwal pesanan dan rekor disimpan hanya dalam sesi server.
local E={sessions={}}
local C
local function copy(value) return value and table.clone(value) or nil end
function E.Init(config) C=config end
function E.Join(player)
	if not E.sessions[player.UserId] then
		E.sessions[player.UserId]={coins=C.InitialCoins,deliveryCount=0,creditedOrders={},bestTimes={},nextOrderIndex=1}
	end
end
function E.Has(player) return E.sessions[player.UserId]~=nil end
function E.PeekAssignment(player)
	local s=E.sessions[player.UserId]
	return table.clone(C.OrderSchedule[s and s.nextOrderIndex or 1])
end
function E.AdvanceAssignment(player)
	local s=E.sessions[player.UserId]
	s.nextOrderIndex=s.nextOrderIndex%#C.OrderSchedule+1
end
function E.GetBest(player,destinationId,packageType)
	local s=E.sessions[player.UserId]
	return s and s.bestTimes[destinationId.."|"..packageType] or nil
end
function E.Snapshot(player)
	local s=E.sessions[player.UserId]
	return {coins=s and s.coins or C.InitialCoins,deliveryCount=s and s.deliveryCount or 0,
		lastResult=s and copy(s.lastResult),bestTimes=s and table.clone(s.bestTimes) or {}}
end
function E.Award(player,order,now)
	local s=E.sessions[player.UserId]
	if not s then return false,"PlayerInactive" end
	if s.creditedOrders[order.orderId] or order.rewardProcessed then return false,"AlreadyRewarded" end
	if order.ownerUserId~=player.UserId or not order.completionLocked or order.status~="Delivered" then return false,"InvalidState" end
	local route=C.Routes[order.destinationId]
	if not route or not C.PackageTypes[order.packageType] then return false,"WrongDestination" end
	local duration=math.max(0,now-order.startedAt)
	local condition=math.clamp(order.condition,0,C.InitialCondition)
	local conditionBonus=math.floor(C.ConditionBonus*condition/C.InitialCondition)
	local timeBonus=math.floor(C.TimeBonus*math.clamp(1-duration/route.TargetSeconds,0,1))
	local key=order.destinationId.."|"..order.packageType
	local previous=s.bestTimes[key]
	local eligible=order.recoveryCount==0
	local newRecord=eligible and (previous==nil or duration<previous)
	local result={
		orderId=order.orderId,destinationId=order.destinationId,destinationName=route.Name,packageType=order.packageType,
		duration=duration,condition=condition,recoveryCount=order.recoveryCount,
		baseReward=C.BaseReward,conditionBonus=conditionBonus,timeBonus=timeBonus,
		total=C.BaseReward+conditionBonus+timeBonus,completedAt=now,
		recordEligible=eligible,recordReason=not eligible and "Recovered" or nil,
		previousBest=previous,newRecord=newRecord,
	}
	-- Tidak ada yield: kunci kredit, koin, rekor, dan hasil bersifat satu transisi.
	order.rewardProcessed=true
	s.creditedOrders[order.orderId]=true
	s.coins+=result.total
	s.deliveryCount+=1
	if newRecord then s.bestTimes[key]=duration end
	result.bestTime=s.bestTimes[key]
	s.lastResult=result
	return true,copy(result)
end
function E.Leave(player) E.sessions[player.UserId]=nil end
return E

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local L = {bindings = {}}
local D, E, W, C
local function disconnect(list)
	for _,connection in ipairs(list) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(list)
end
function L.Unbind(player)
	local b = L.bindings[player]
	if b then
		disconnect(b.characterConnections)
		disconnect(b.playerConnections)
		L.bindings[player] = nil
	end
	D.RemovePlayer(player)
end
function L.Bind(player)
	if L.bindings[player] then return end
	E.Join(player)
	player.RespawnLocation = W.Map.PrototypeSpawn
	local b = {characterConnections = {}, playerConnections = {}}
	L.bindings[player] = b
	local function character(char)
		if L.bindings[player] ~= b or player.Character ~= char then return end
		b.character = char
		disconnect(b.characterConnections)
		D.Cancel(player, "Respawned")
		local function group(v) if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CollisionGroup = "PKCharacters" end end
		for _,v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do group(v) end
		table.insert(b.characterConnections, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(group))
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		local r = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		if not hum or not r or L.bindings[player] ~= b or player.Character ~= char or player.Parent ~= Players then return end
		table.insert(b.characterConnections, hum.Died:Connect(function()
			if b.character == char and player.Character == char then D.Cancel(player, "Cancelled") end
		end))
		char:PivotTo(W.Map.PrototypeSpawn.CFrame + C.SpawnOffset)
	end
	table.insert(b.playerConnections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(character))
	table.insert(b.playerConnections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(char)
		if b.character ~= char then return end
		b.character = nil
		disconnect(b.characterConnections)
		D.Cancel(player, "Cancelled")
	end))
	if player.Character then task.spawn(character, player.Character) end
end
function L.Start(delivery, economy, world, config)
	D, E, W, C = delivery, economy, world, config
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(L.Bind)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(L.Unbind)
	for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do L.Bind(player) end
end
return L

-- State otoritatif server. Semua transisi sinkron tanpa yield.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Delivery = { orders = {}, requests = {} }
local C, P, W, emit
function Delivery.Init(config, packages, world, publish)
	C, P, W, emit = config, packages, world, publish
end
local function root(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
end
local function near(player, point)
	local r = root(player)
	return r ~= nil and (r.Position - point).Magnitude <= C.ActionDistance
end
function Delivery.Snapshot(player)
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if not o then return { status = "Idle" } end
	return {
		orderId = o.orderId, ownerUserId = o.ownerUserId, packageType = o.packageType,
		destinationId = o.destinationId, destinationName = C.DestinationName, status = o.status,
		condition = o.condition, startedAt = o.startedAt, rewardProcessed = o.rewardProcessed,
		completionLocked = o.completionLocked, recoveryCount = o.recoveryCount,
		lastRecoveryAt = o.lastRecoveryAt, outOfBounds = o.outOfBounds,
	}
end
function Delivery.Publish(player, code)
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if o then P.Update(o) end
	emit(player, Delivery.Snapshot(player), code)
end
function Delivery.Handle(player, action, orderId)
	if type(action) ~= "string" or #action > 16 or (orderId ~= nil and (type(orderId) ~= "string" or #orderId > 64)) then
		return false, "InvalidArguments"
	end
	local allowed = { Start = true, Pickup = true, Drop = true, Recover = true, Sync = true }
	if not allowed[action] then return false, "UnknownAction" end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (Delivery.requests[player.UserId] or -math.huge) < C.RequestCooldown then return false, "RateLimited" end
	Delivery.requests[player.UserId] = now
	if action == "Sync" then Delivery.Publish(player, "Sync"); return true, "Sync" end
	if not root(player) then return false, "NotAlive" end
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if action == "Start" then
		if o then return false, "OrderActive" end
		if not near(player, W.Map.Depot.PickupPoint.Position) then return false, "TooFar" end
		o = {
			orderId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), ownerUserId = player.UserId,
			packageType = C.PackageType, destinationId = C.DestinationId, status = "Carrying",
			condition = C.InitialCondition, startedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
			rewardProcessed = false, completionLocked = false, recoveryCount = 0,
			lastRecoveryAt = -1, lastRecoveryClock = -math.huge, lastDamageAt = -math.huge,
			outOfBounds = false, player = player,
		}
		Delivery.orders[player.UserId] = o
		P.Create(o)
		P.Carry(o, root(player))
	else
		if not o or o.ownerUserId ~= player.UserId or o.orderId ~= orderId then return false, "NotOwnerOrStale" end
		if o.completionLocked then return false, "CompletionLocked" end
		if action == "Pickup" then
			if o.status ~= "Dropped" then return false, "InvalidState" end
			if o.outOfBounds or not near(player, o.package.Position) then return false, "TooFar" end
			o.status = "Carrying"
			P.Carry(o, root(player))
		elseif action == "Drop" then
			if o.status ~= "Carrying" then return false, "InvalidState" end
			o.status = "Dropped"
			P.Drop(o, root(player))
		elseif action == "Recover" then
			if o.status ~= "Dropped" then return false, "InvalidState" end
			if now - o.lastRecoveryClock < C.RecoveryCooldown then return false, "RecoveryCooldown" end
			o.lastRecoveryClock, o.lastRecoveryAt = now, workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			o.recoveryCount += 1
			o.condition = math.clamp(o.condition - C.RecoveryPenalty, 0, C.InitialCondition)
			o.outOfBounds = false
			P.Recover(o)
			local r = root(player)
			local relative = r.Position - W.Map.DepotPad.Position
			local lo, hi = C.BoundsMin, C.BoundsMax
			if relative.Y < 0 or relative.X < lo.X or relative.X > hi.X or relative.Z < lo.Z or relative.Z > hi.Z or relative.Y > hi.Y then
				player.Character:PivotTo(W.Map.PrototypeSpawn.CFrame + C.RecoveryPlayerOffset)
				r.AssemblyLinearVelocity, r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
			end
		end
	end
	Delivery.Publish(player, action)
	return true, action
end
function Delivery.Impact(o)
	if Delivery.orders[o.ownerUserId] ~= o or o.completionLocked or o.outOfBounds then return false end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - o.lastDamageAt < C.DamageCooldown then return false end
	if o.status ~= "Carrying" and o.status ~= "Dropped" then return false end
	o.lastDamageAt = now
	o.condition = math.clamp(o.condition - C.ImpactDamage, 0, C.InitialCondition)
	if o.status == "Carrying" then
		o.status = "Dropped"
		P.Drop(o, root(o.player))
	end
	Delivery.Publish(o.player, "Impact")
	return true
end
function Delivery.OutOfBounds(o)
	if o.outOfBounds or Delivery.orders[o.ownerUserId] ~= o then return end
	if o.status == "Carrying" then o.status = "Dropped"; P.Drop(o, root(o.player)) end
	o.outOfBounds = true
	P.Hold(o)
	Delivery.Publish(o.player, "OutOfBounds")
end
-- Kontrak internal untuk T07; tidak dipanggil RemoteEvent tahap pertama.
function Delivery.ValidateCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if not o or o.ownerUserId ~= player.UserId or o.orderId ~= orderId then return false, "NotOwnerOrStale" end
	if o.completionLocked or o.rewardProcessed then return false, "CompletionLocked" end
	if o.status ~= "Carrying" then return false, "InvalidState" end
	if destinationId ~= o.destinationId then return false, "WrongDestination" end
	if not near(player, W.Map.Rumah01.DestinationPoint.Position) then return false, "TooFar" end
	return true, "Valid"
end
function Delivery.LockCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	local ok, code = Delivery.ValidateCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	if ok then Delivery.orders[player.UserId].completionLocked = true end
	return ok, code
end
function Delivery.Cancel(player)
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if o then P.Destroy(o); Delivery.orders[player.UserId] = nil end
	Delivery.requests[player.UserId] = nil
	Delivery.Publish(player, "Cancelled")
end
return Delivery

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("PaketKilat")
local C = require(RS.Shared.Config)
local ui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("PaketKilatUI").Root
local card, actions = ui.TopCard, ui.Actions
local state, synced = {status = "Idle", coins = 0}, false
local feedback, feedbackUntil = "", 0
local messages = {
	TooFar = "Dekati titik tujuan atau paket terlebih dahulu.",
	WrongDestination = "Rumah ini bukan tujuan pesananmu.",
	NotOwnerOrStale = "Paket ini bukan pesanan aktifmu.",
	OrderActive = "Selesaikan pesanan yang sedang aktif.",
	InvalidState = "Aksi belum tersedia untuk paket ini.",
	RecoveryCooldown = "Pemulihan masih menunggu jeda.",
	NotAlive = "Menunggu muncul kembali di depot...",
	Respawned = "Siap! Ambil pesanan di depot.",
	Cancelled = "Pesanan dibatalkan. Saldo sesi tetap.",
	Impact = "Paket terbentur! Dekati paket atau pulihkan.",
	OutOfBounds = "Paket jatuh. Pulihkan untuk kembali ke depot.",
	Recover = "Pulih (-20). Ambil ulang; perjalanan tanpa rekor.",
	Drop = "Paket dilepas. Dekati untuk mengambil ulang.",
	Pickup = "Paket dibawa kembali. Ayo ke rumah tujuan!",
	Start = "Pesanan diambil. Ikuti penanda tujuan.",
	Slip = "Licin! Paket terlepas. Ambil ulang atau pulihkan.",
	Barrier = "Terkena penghalang! Ambil ulang atau pulihkan.",
	UnavailableDestination = "Titik tujuan belum siap.",
	InvalidArguments = "Permintaan tidak valid.",
	PlayerInactive = "Menunggu sesi siap...",
	CompletionLocked = "Pesanan sedang diselesaikan.",
}
local marker = Instance.new("Part")
marker.Name, marker.Anchored, marker.Transparency = "PaketKilat_LocalDestination", true, 1
marker.CanCollide, marker.CanTouch, marker.CanQuery, marker.Archivable = false, false, false, false
marker.Parent = workspace
local label = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
label.Name, label.Size, label.StudsOffset = "DestinationMarker", UDim2.fromOffset(180,48), Vector3.new(0,5,0)
label.AlwaysOnTop, label.MaxDistance, label.Enabled, label.Parent = true, 500, false, marker
local markerText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
markerText.Size, markerText.BackgroundColor3 = UDim2.fromScale(1,1), Color3.fromRGB(27,42,58)
markerText.BackgroundTransparency, markerText.TextColor3 = 0.15, Color3.fromRGB(255,211,97)
markerText.Font, markerText.TextSize, markerText.TextWrapped = Enum.Font.GothamBold, 15, true
markerText.Parent = label
local sfx=Instance.new("Folder")
sfx.Name="PaketKilatSFX"
sfx.Parent=game:GetService("SoundService")
local cues={}
for name,settings in pairs(C.Audio) do
	local sound=Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name,sound.SoundId,sound.Volume,sound.PlaybackSpeed=name,settings.Id,settings.Volume,settings.Speed
	sound:SetAttribute("PlayCount",0)
	sound:SetAttribute("EndedCount",0)
	sound.Ended:Connect(function() sound:SetAttribute("EndedCount",(sound:GetAttribute("EndedCount") or 0)+1) end)
	sound.Parent=sfx
	cues[name]=sound
end
task.spawn(function()
	local list={}
	for _,sound in pairs(cues) do table.insert(list,sound) end
	local ok,err=pcall(function() ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(list) end)
	sfx:SetAttribute("PreloadSucceeded",ok)
	if not ok then warn("[PaketKilat] Audio preload:",err) end
end)
local function cue(name)
	local sound=cues[name]
	sound:Stop()
	sound:Play()
	sound:SetAttribute("PlayCount",(sound:GetAttribute("PlayCount") or 0)+1)
	local stroke=card:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
	if stroke then
		stroke.Color=name=="Impact" and Color3.fromRGB(255,128,91) or Color3.fromRGB(109,236,175)
		TweenService:Create(stroke,TweenInfo.new(0.6),{Color=Color3.fromRGB(75,109,132)}):Play()
	end
end
local function aliveRoot()
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
end
local function near(point)
	local r = aliveRoot()
	return r ~= nil and typeof(point) == "Vector3" and (r.Position-point).Magnitude <= C.ActionDistance
end
local function ownPackage()
	local world = workspace:FindFirstChild("PaketKilat")
	local folder = world and world:FindFirstChild("ActivePackages")
	if folder then
		for _,p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			if p:GetAttribute("orderId") == state.orderId and p:GetAttribute("ownerUserId") == player.UserId then return p end
		end
	end
end
local function button(b, action, text, enabled, key)
	b:SetAttribute("Action",action)
	b:SetAttribute("ActionEnabled",enabled)
	b.Active, b.AutoButtonColor = enabled, enabled
	b.Text = text .. ((not UIS.TouchEnabled and key) and (" ["..key.."]") or "")
	b.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(255,202,77) or Color3.fromRGB(54,73,91)
	b.TextColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(27,42,58) or Color3.fromRGB(181,197,208)
end
local function bestText(value)
	return value and string.format("%.1f dtk",value) or "—"
end
local function render()
	local w=ui.AbsoluteSize.X
	card.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(w*0.42,270,360),156)
	card.Coins.Text=string.format("%d koin",state.coins or 0)
	local last,nextOrder=state.lastResult,state.nextOrder
	local condition=state.condition or (last and last.condition) or 0
	card.ConditionTrack.Fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(condition/100,0,1),1)
	card.ConditionTrack.Fill.BackgroundColor3=condition>40 and Color3.fromRGB(98,222,175) or Color3.fromRGB(255,170,91)
	if state.status=="Idle" then
		card.Destination.Text=last and ("Selesai · "..last.destinationName) or ("Berikut · "..(nextOrder and nextOrder.destinationName or C.DestinationName))
		card.ConditionText.Text=last and string.format("%s · %d/100 · %.1f dtk",last.packageType,last.condition,last.duration)
			or string.format("%s · Rekor %s",nextOrder and nextOrder.packageType or C.PackageType,bestText(nextOrder and nextOrder.bestTime))
	else
		card.Destination.Text="Tujuan · "..(state.destinationName or C.DestinationName)
		card.ConditionText.Text=string.format("%s · %d/100 · Rekor %s",state.packageType,condition,bestText(state.currentBestTime))
	end
	if os.clock()<feedbackUntil then card.Hint.Text=feedback
	elseif state.status=="Idle" and last then
		local record=not last.recordEligible and "Tanpa rekor: paket dipulihkan"
			or (last.newRecord and ("REKOR BARU: "..bestText(last.bestTime)) or ("Terbaik sesi: "..bestText(last.bestTime)))
		card.Hint.Text=string.format("+%d: dasar %d · kondisi %d · waktu %d\n%s",last.total,last.baseReward,last.conditionBonus,last.timeBonus,record)
	elseif state.status=="Carrying" then
		card.Hint.Text=state.packageType=="Rapuh" and "RAPUH: benturan lebih merusak. Jaga paket!" or "Pilih jalan aman atau pintasan. Antar di petak rumah."
	elseif state.status=="Dropped" then card.Hint.Text="Ambil ulang, atau pulihkan (-20; tanpa rekor)."
	else card.Hint.Text="Lima rumah, dua jenis paket. Ambil di depot." end
	actions.Secondary.Visible=state.status~="Idle" and synced
	if not synced then button(actions.Primary,"","Memuat...",false)
	elseif state.status=="Idle" then button(actions.Primary,"Start",near(state.depotPosition) and C.Labels.Start or "Ke depot",near(state.depotPosition),"E")
	elseif state.status=="Carrying" then
		button(actions.Primary,"Deliver",near(state.destinationPosition) and C.Labels.Deliver or "Ke rumah",near(state.destinationPosition),"E")
		button(actions.Secondary,"Drop",C.Labels.Drop,aliveRoot()~=nil,"Q")
	elseif state.status=="Dropped" then
		local p=ownPackage()
		local canPickup=p~=nil and not state.outOfBounds and near(p.Position)
		button(actions.Primary,"Pickup",canPickup and C.Labels.Pickup or "Ke paket",canPickup,"E")
		local remaining=math.max(0,C.RecoveryCooldown-(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-(state.lastRecoveryAt or -100)))
		button(actions.Secondary,"Recover",remaining>0 and string.format("Pulihkan (%d)",math.ceil(remaining)) or C.Labels.Recover,remaining<=0 and aliveRoot()~=nil,"R")
	end
	local markerTarget=state.status=="Idle" and state.depotPosition or state.destinationPosition
	label.Enabled=synced and markerTarget~=nil and (state.status~="Idle" or not near(state.depotPosition))
	if label.Enabled then
		marker.CFrame=CFrame.new(markerTarget)
		markerText.Text=state.status=="Idle" and "DEPOT\nAmbil pesanan" or ("TUJUAN · "..state.packageType.."\n"..state.destinationName)
	end
end
local function activate(b)
	if b:GetAttribute("ActionEnabled") then
		local action=b:GetAttribute("Action")
		RS.Remotes.ActionRequest:FireServer(action,state.orderId,action=="Deliver" and state.destinationId or nil)
	end
end
actions.Primary.Activated:Connect(function() activate(actions.Primary) end)
actions.Secondary.Activated:Connect(function() activate(actions.Secondary) end)
CAS:BindAction("PKInteract",function(_,s)
	if s == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then activate(actions.Primary) end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end,false,Enum.KeyCode.E)
CAS:BindAction("PKDrop",function(_,s)
	if s == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and state.status == "Carrying" then activate(actions.Secondary) end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end,false,Enum.KeyCode.Q)
CAS:BindAction("PKRecover",function(_,s)
	if s == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and state.status == "Dropped" then activate(actions.Secondary) end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end,false,Enum.KeyCode.R)
RS.Remotes.StateChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(snapshot,code)
	state,synced = snapshot,true
	ui:SetAttribute("Status",state.status)
	ui:SetAttribute("LastCode",code)
	ui:SetAttribute("Coins",state.coins)
	ui:SetAttribute("OrderId",state.orderId)
	if code=="Start" or code=="Pickup" then cue("Pickup")
	elseif code=="Impact" or code=="Slip" or code=="Barrier" then cue("Impact")
	elseif code=="Delivered" then cue("Delivered") end
	if messages[code] then feedback,feedbackUntil = messages[code],os.clock()+3
	elseif code == "Delivered" then feedbackUntil=0 end
	render()
end)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.delay(0.5,function() RS.Remotes.ActionRequest:FireServer("Sync") end)
end)
local elapsed=0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	elapsed+=dt
	if elapsed>=C.UIUpdateInterval then elapsed=0; render() end
end)
render()
RS.Remotes.ActionRequest:FireServer("Sync")

	Labels = table.freeze({

	}),
})

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local L = {bindings = {}}
local D, E, W, C
local function disconnect(list)
	for _,connection in ipairs(list) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(list)
end
function L.Unbind(player)
	local b = L.bindings[player]
	if b then
		disconnect(b.characterConnections)
		disconnect(b.playerConnections)
		L.bindings[player] = nil
	end
	D.RemovePlayer(player)
end
function L.Bind(player)
	if L.bindings[player] then return end
	E.Join(player)
	player.RespawnLocation = W.Map.PrototypeSpawn
	local b = {characterConnections = {}, playerConnections = {}}
	L.bindings[player] = b
	local function character(char)
		if L.bindings[player] ~= b or player.Character ~= char then return end
		b.character = char
		disconnect(b.characterConnections)
		D.Cancel(player, "Respawned")
		local function group(v) if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CollisionGroup = "PKCharacters" end end
		for _,v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do group(v) end
		table.insert(b.characterConnections, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(group))
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		local r = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		if not hum or not r or L.bindings[player] ~= b or player.Character ~= char or player.Parent ~= Players then return end
		table.insert(b.characterConnections, hum.Died:Connect(function()
			if b.character == char and player.Character == char then D.Cancel(player, "Cancelled") end
		end))
		char:PivotTo(W.Map.PrototypeSpawn.CFrame + C.SpawnOffset)
	end
	table.insert(b.playerConnections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(character))
	table.insert(b.playerConnections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(char)
		if b.character ~= char then return end
		b.character = nil
		disconnect(b.characterConnections)
		D.Cancel(player, "Cancelled")
	end))
	if player.Character then task.spawn(character, player.Character) end
end
function L.Start(delivery, economy, world, config)
	D, E, W, C = delivery, economy, world, config
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(L.Bind)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(L.Unbind)
	for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do L.Bind(player) end
end
return L

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local P = {}
local C, W, D, template
function P.Init(config, world, delivery, packageTemplate)
	C, W, D, template = config, world, delivery, packageTemplate
end
function P.Update(o)
	local p = o.package
	if not p then return end
	for _,key in ipairs({"orderId", "ownerUserId", "packageType", "destinationId", "status", "condition", "outOfBounds"}) do p:SetAttribute(key, o[key]) end
	p.Color = C.PackageTypes[o.packageType].Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(145,90,65),1-o.condition/100)
	p.Label.TextLabel.Text = string.format("%s → %s\n%s · %d/100%s", string.upper(o.packageType), C.Routes[o.destinationId].Name, o.status=="Carrying" and "Dibawa" or "Terlepas", o.condition, o.outOfBounds and " · Pulihkan!" or "")
	p.PickupPrompt.Enabled = false -- HUD menangani ambil ulang pada komputer/sentuh.
end
function P.Create(o)
	local p = template:Clone()
	p.Name = o.orderId
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(W.Map.Depot.PickupPoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	p.Parent = W.ActivePackages
	o.package = p
	o.promptConnection = p.PickupPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local ok, code = D.Handle(player, "Pickup", o.orderId)
		if not ok then D.Publish(player, code) end
	end)
end
local function unweld(o)
	if o.weld then o.weld:Destroy(); o.weld = nil end
end
local function resetSample(o)
	o.previousPosition, o.previousVelocity, o.previousSampleAt = nil, nil, nil
end
function P.Carry(o, r)
	unweld(o)
	local p = o.package
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.Massless = false, false, true
	p.CollisionGroup = "PKCarried"
	p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	p.CFrame = r.CFrame * C.CarryOffset
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = "CarryWeld", r, p, p
	o.weld = weld
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Drop(o, r)
	unweld(o)
	local p = o.package
	p.Anchored, p.Massless, p.CanCollide = false, false, true
	p.CollisionGroup = "PKDropped"
	if r then
		local desired = r.CFrame * C.DropOffset
		-- Jangan menaruh paket di balik dinding ketika dilepas.
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {o.player.Character, W.ActivePackages}
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(r.Position, desired.Position - r.Position, params)
		p.CFrame = hit and CFrame.new(hit.Position - (desired.Position - r.Position).Unit * 2) or desired
	end
	p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	p:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Hold(o)
	unweld(o)
	o.package.AssemblyLinearVelocity, o.package.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	o.package.Anchored = true
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Recover(o)
	P.Drop(o, nil)
	o.package.CFrame = CFrame.new(W.Map.RecoveryPoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, C.PackageSize.Y / 2 + 0.4, 0))
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Destroy(o)
	if o.promptConnection then o.promptConnection:Disconnect() end
	unweld(o)
	if o.package then o.package:Destroy() end
end
function P.Start()
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < C.PhysicsSampleInterval then return end
		elapsed = 0
		local excluded = {W.ActivePackages}
		for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player.Character then table.insert(excluded, player.Character) end end
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
		params.RespectCanCollide = true
		for _,o in pairs(D.orders) do
			local p = o.package
			if not p or not p.Parent or o.outOfBounds then continue end
			local pos = p.Position - W.Map.DepotPad.Position
			local lo, hi = C.BoundsMin, C.BoundsMax
			if pos.X < lo.X or pos.Y < lo.Y or pos.Z < lo.Z or pos.X > hi.X or pos.Y > hi.Y or pos.Z > hi.Z then
				D.OutOfBounds(o)
				continue
			end
			local subject, radius = p, p.Size.Y / 2
			if o.status == "Carrying" then
				local char = o.player.Character
				subject = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if subject and hum then radius = hum.HipHeight + subject.Size.Y / 2 end
			end
			if not subject then continue end
			local current, velocity = subject.Position, subject.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local sampleTime = os.clock()
			if o.previousPosition and o.previousVelocity then
				local previous = o.previousVelocity
				local delta = current - o.previousPosition
				local inferred = delta / math.max(sampleTime - (o.previousSampleAt or sampleTime), C.PhysicsSampleInterval)
				if (o.status == "Carrying" and inferred.Y < previous.Y) or (o.status == "Dropped" and inferred.Magnitude > previous.Magnitude) then previous = inferred end
				local speed = o.status == "Carrying" and math.max(0, -previous.Y) or previous.Magnitude
				if speed >= C.ImpactSpeed then
					local hit = delta.Magnitude > 0.01 and workspace:Raycast(o.previousPosition, delta + delta.Unit * (radius + C.ContactMargin), params)
					local direction = o.status == "Carrying" and Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) or previous.Unit
					hit = hit or workspace:Raycast(current, direction * (radius + C.ContactMargin), params)
					if hit and -previous:Dot(hit.Normal) >= C.ImpactSpeed then
						D.Impact(o)
					end
				end
			end
			o.previousPosition, o.previousVelocity, o.previousSampleAt = current, velocity, sampleTime
		end

function P.Init(config, world, delivery, packageTemplate)

end
function P.Update(o)
	local p = o.package
	if not p then return end
	for _,key in ipairs({"orderId", "ownerUserId", "status", "condition", "outOfBounds"}) do p:SetAttribute(key, o[key]) end
	p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(183, 113 + math.floor(o.condition / 3), 64)
	p.Label.TextLabel.Text = string.format("%s · %s\n%s · %d/100%s", o.player.DisplayName, C.DestinationName, o.status, o.condition, o.outOfBounds and " · R: Pulihkan" or "")
	p.PickupPrompt.Enabled = false -- HUD menangani ambil ulang pada komputer/sentuh.
end
function P.Create(o)
	local p = template:Clone()
	p.Name = o.orderId
	p.CFrame = CFrame.new(W.Map.Depot.PickupPoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	p.Parent = W.ActivePackages
	o.package = p
	o.promptConnection = p.PickupPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local ok, code = D.Handle(player, "Pickup", o.orderId)
		if not ok then D.Publish(player, code) end
	end)
end
local function unweld(o)
	if o.weld then o.weld:Destroy(); o.weld = nil end
end
local function resetSample(o)
	o.previousPosition, o.previousVelocity = nil, nil
end
function P.Carry(o, r)
	unweld(o)
	local p = o.package
	p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.Massless = false, false, true
	p.CollisionGroup = "PKCarried"
	p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	p.CFrame = r.CFrame * C.CarryOffset
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = "CarryWeld", r, p, p
	o.weld = weld
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Drop(o, r)
	unweld(o)
	local p = o.package
	p.Anchored, p.Massless, p.CanCollide = false, false, true
	p.CollisionGroup = "PKDropped"
	if r then
		local desired = r.CFrame * C.DropOffset
		-- Jangan menaruh paket di balik dinding ketika dilepas.
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {o.player.Character, W.ActivePackages}
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(r.Position, desired.Position - r.Position, params)
		p.CFrame = hit and CFrame.new(hit.Position - (desired.Position - r.Position).Unit * 2) or desired
	end
	p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	p:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Hold(o)
	unweld(o)
	o.package.AssemblyLinearVelocity, o.package.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
	o.package.Anchored = true
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Recover(o)
	P.Drop(o, nil)
	o.package.CFrame = CFrame.new(W.Map.RecoveryPoint.Position + Vector3.new(0, C.PackageSize.Y / 2 + 0.4, 0))
	resetSample(o)
end
function P.Destroy(o)
	if o.promptConnection then o.promptConnection:Disconnect() end
	unweld(o)
	if o.package then o.package:Destroy() end
end
function P.Start()
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < C.PhysicsSampleInterval then return end
		elapsed = 0
		local excluded = {W.ActivePackages}
		for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player.Character then table.insert(excluded, player.Character) end end
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
		params.RespectCanCollide = true
		for _,o in pairs(D.orders) do
			local p = o.package
			if not p or not p.Parent or o.outOfBounds then continue end
			local pos = p.Position - W.Map.DepotPad.Position
			local lo, hi = C.BoundsMin, C.BoundsMax
			if pos.X < lo.X or pos.Y < lo.Y or pos.Z < lo.Z or pos.X > hi.X or pos.Y > hi.Y or pos.Z > hi.Z then
				D.OutOfBounds(o)
				continue
			end
			local subject, radius = p, p.Size.Y / 2
			if o.status == "Carrying" then
				local char = o.player.Character
				subject = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if subject and hum then radius = hum.HipHeight + subject.Size.Y / 2 end
			end
			if not subject then continue end
			local current, velocity = subject.Position, subject.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			if o.previousPosition and o.previousVelocity then
				local previous = o.previousVelocity
				local speed = o.status == "Carrying" and math.max(0, -previous.Y) or previous.Magnitude
				if speed >= C.ImpactSpeed then
					local delta = current - o.previousPosition
					local hit = delta.Magnitude > 0.01 and workspace:Raycast(o.previousPosition, delta + delta.Unit * (radius + C.ContactMargin), params)
					local direction = o.status == "Carrying" and Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) or previous.Unit
					hit = hit or workspace:Raycast(current, direction * (radius + C.ContactMargin), params)
					if hit and -previous:Dot(hit.Normal) >= C.ImpactSpeed then
						D.Impact(o)
					end
				end
			end
			o.previousPosition, o.previousVelocity = current, velocity
		end
	end)
end
return P

local E = {sessions = {}}
local C
local function copy(value)
	if not value then return nil end
	return table.clone(value)
end
function E.Init(config) C = config end
function E.Join(player)
	if not E.sessions[player.UserId] then
		E.sessions[player.UserId] = {coins = C.InitialCoins, deliveryCount = 0, creditedOrders = {}}
	end
end
function E.Has(player) return E.sessions[player.UserId] ~= nil end
function E.Snapshot(player)
	local s = E.sessions[player.UserId]
	return {coins = s and s.coins or C.InitialCoins, deliveryCount = s and s.deliveryCount or 0, lastResult = s and copy(s.lastResult)}
end
function E.Award(player, order, now)
	local s = E.sessions[player.UserId]
	if not s then return false, "PlayerInactive" end
	if s.creditedOrders[order.orderId] or order.rewardProcessed then return false, "AlreadyRewarded" end
	if order.ownerUserId ~= player.UserId or not order.completionLocked or order.status ~= "Delivered" then return false, "InvalidState" end
	local duration = math.max(0, now - order.startedAt)
	local route = C.Routes[order.destinationId]
	if not route then return false, "WrongDestination" end
	local condition = math.clamp(order.condition, 0, C.InitialCondition)
	local conditionBonus = math.floor(C.ConditionBonus * condition / C.InitialCondition)
	local timeBonus = math.floor(C.TimeBonus * math.clamp(1 - duration / route.TargetSeconds, 0, 1))
	local result = {
		orderId = order.orderId, destinationId = order.destinationId, destinationName = C.DestinationName,
		duration = duration, condition = condition, recoveryCount = order.recoveryCount,
		baseReward = C.BaseReward, conditionBonus = conditionBonus, timeBonus = timeBonus,
		total = C.BaseReward + conditionBonus + timeBonus, completedAt = now,
	}
	-- Tidak ada yield di antara guard, tanda kredit, dan perubahan saldo.
	order.rewardProcessed = true
	s.creditedOrders[order.orderId] = true
	s.coins += result.total
	s.deliveryCount += 1
	s.lastResult = result
	return true, copy(result)
end
function E.Leave(player) E.sessions[player.UserId] = nil end
return E

-- Seluruh transisi dan kredit resmi berjalan sinkron di server.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Delivery = {orders = {}, requests = {}}
local C, P, W, emit, E, H
function Delivery.Init(config, packages, world, publish, economy, hazards)
	C, P, W, emit, E, H = config, packages, world, publish, economy, hazards
end
local function root(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
end
local function near(player, point)
	local r = root(player)
	return r ~= nil and (r.Position - point).Magnitude <= C.ActionDistance
end
local function destinationPoint(id)
	local model=W.Map:FindFirstChild(id)
	return model and model:FindFirstChild("DestinationPoint")
end
function Delivery.Snapshot(player)
	local snapshot = E.Snapshot(player)
	snapshot.status = "Idle"
	snapshot.depotPosition = W.Map.Depot.PickupPoint.Position
	snapshot.recoveryPosition = W.Map.RecoveryPoint.Position
	local nextAssignment=E.PeekAssignment(player)
	local nextRoute=C.Routes[nextAssignment.DestinationId]
	snapshot.nextOrder={destinationId=nextAssignment.DestinationId,destinationName=nextRoute.Name,
		packageType=nextAssignment.PackageType,targetSeconds=nextRoute.TargetSeconds,
		bestTime=E.GetBest(player,nextAssignment.DestinationId,nextAssignment.PackageType)}
	local point=destinationPoint(nextAssignment.DestinationId)
	snapshot.destinationPosition=point and point.Position
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if o then
		for _,key in ipairs({"orderId","ownerUserId","packageType","destinationId","status","condition","startedAt","rewardProcessed","completionLocked","recoveryCount","lastRecoveryAt","outOfBounds"}) do snapshot[key] = o[key] end
		snapshot.destinationName=C.Routes[o.destinationId].Name
		local point=destinationPoint(o.destinationId)
		snapshot.destinationPosition=point and point.Position
		snapshot.currentBestTime=E.GetBest(player,o.destinationId,o.packageType)
	end
	return snapshot
end
function Delivery.Publish(player, code)
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if o then P.Update(o) end
	emit(player, Delivery.Snapshot(player), code)
end
function Delivery.ValidateCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	if not E.Has(player) then return false, "PlayerInactive" end
	if not root(player) then return false, "NotAlive" end
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if not o or o.ownerUserId ~= player.UserId or o.orderId ~= orderId then return false, "NotOwnerOrStale" end
	if o.completionLocked or o.rewardProcessed then return false, "CompletionLocked" end
	if o.status ~= "Carrying" or o.outOfBounds or not o.package or not o.package.Parent then return false, "InvalidState" end
	if destinationId ~= o.destinationId then return false, "WrongDestination" end
	local target=destinationPoint(o.destinationId)
	if not target then return false,"UnavailableDestination" end
	local point=target.Position
	if not near(player, point) or not ((o.package.Position - point).Magnitude <= C.PackageDeliveryDistance) then return false, "TooFar" end
	return true, "Valid"
end
function Delivery.LockCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	local ok, code = Delivery.ValidateCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	if ok then Delivery.orders[player.UserId].completionLocked = true end
	return ok, code
end
function Delivery.Complete(player, orderId, destinationId)
	local ok, code = Delivery.LockCompletion(player, orderId, destinationId)
	if not ok then return false, code end
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	o.status = "Delivered"
	local awarded, result = E.Award(player, o, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
	if not awarded then o.status, o.completionLocked = "Carrying", false; return false, result end
	P.Destroy(o)
	Delivery.orders[player.UserId] = nil
	Delivery.Publish(player, "Delivered")
	return true, "Delivered"
end
function Delivery.Handle(player, action, orderId, destinationId)
	if not E.Has(player) then return false, "PlayerInactive" end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (Delivery.requests[player.UserId] or -math.huge) < C.RequestCooldown then return false, "RateLimited" end
	Delivery.requests[player.UserId] = now
	if type(action) ~= "string" or #action > 16
		or (orderId ~= nil and (type(orderId) ~= "string" or #orderId > 64))
		or (destinationId ~= nil and (type(destinationId) ~= "string" or #destinationId > 64)) then return false, "InvalidArguments" end
	local allowed = {Start = true, Pickup = true, Drop = true, Recover = true, Sync = true, Deliver = true}
	if not allowed[action] then return false, "UnknownAction" end
	if (action == "Deliver" and type(destinationId) ~= "string") or (action ~= "Deliver" and destinationId ~= nil) then return false, "InvalidArguments" end
	if action == "Sync" then Delivery.Publish(player, "Sync"); return true, "Sync" end
	if not root(player) then return false, "NotAlive" end
	if action == "Deliver" then return Delivery.Complete(player, orderId, destinationId) end
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if action == "Start" then
		if o then return false, "OrderActive" end
		if not near(player, W.Map.Depot.PickupPoint.Position) then return false, "TooFar" end
		local assignment=E.PeekAssignment(player)
		o = {
			orderId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), ownerUserId = player.UserId,
			packageType = assignment.PackageType, destinationId = assignment.DestinationId, status = "Carrying",
			condition = C.InitialCondition, startedAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
			rewardProcessed = false, completionLocked = false, recoveryCount = 0,
			lastRecoveryAt = -1, lastRecoveryClock = -math.huge, lastDamageAt = -math.huge,
			outOfBounds = false, player = player,
		}
		Delivery.orders[player.UserId] = o
		P.Create(o)
		P.Carry(o, root(player))
		E.AdvanceAssignment(player)
	else
		if not o or o.ownerUserId ~= player.UserId or o.orderId ~= orderId then return false, "NotOwnerOrStale" end
		if o.completionLocked then return false, "CompletionLocked" end
		if action == "Pickup" then
			if o.status ~= "Dropped" then return false, "InvalidState" end
			if o.outOfBounds or not o.package or not o.package.Parent or not near(player, o.package.Position) then return false, "TooFar" end
			o.status = "Carrying"
			P.Carry(o, root(player))
		elseif action == "Drop" then
			if o.status ~= "Carrying" then return false, "InvalidState" end
			o.status = "Dropped"
			P.Drop(o, root(player))
		elseif action == "Recover" then
			if o.status ~= "Dropped" then return false, "InvalidState" end
			if now - o.lastRecoveryClock < C.RecoveryCooldown then return false, "RecoveryCooldown" end
			o.lastRecoveryClock, o.lastRecoveryAt = now, workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			o.recoveryCount += 1
			o.condition = math.clamp(o.condition - C.RecoveryPenalty, 0, C.InitialCondition)
			o.outOfBounds = false
			if H then H.Clear(player) end
			P.Recover(o)
			local r = root(player)
			local relative = r.Position - W.Map.DepotPad.Position
			local lo, hi = C.BoundsMin, C.BoundsMax
			if relative.Y < 0 or relative.X < lo.X or relative.X > hi.X or relative.Z < lo.Z or relative.Z > hi.Z or relative.Y > hi.Y then
				player.Character:PivotTo(W.Map.PrototypeSpawn.CFrame + C.RecoveryPlayerOffset)
				r.AssemblyLinearVelocity, r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
			end
		end
	end
	Delivery.Publish(player, action)
	return true, action
end
function Delivery.Impact(o, cause)
	if Delivery.orders[o.ownerUserId] ~= o or o.completionLocked or o.outOfBounds then return false end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - o.lastDamageAt < C.DamageCooldown then return false end
	if o.status ~= "Carrying" and o.status ~= "Dropped" then return false end
	o.lastDamageAt = now
	o.condition = math.clamp(o.condition - C.PackageTypes[o.packageType].ImpactDamage, 0, C.InitialCondition)
	if o.status == "Carrying" then o.status = "Dropped"; P.Drop(o, root(o.player)) end
	Delivery.Publish(o.player, cause or "Impact")
	return true
end
function Delivery.OutOfBounds(o)
	if o.outOfBounds or Delivery.orders[o.ownerUserId] ~= o then return end
	if o.status == "Carrying" then o.status = "Dropped"; P.Drop(o, root(o.player)) end
	o.outOfBounds = true
	P.Hold(o)
	Delivery.Publish(o.player, "OutOfBounds")
end
function Delivery.Cancel(player, code)
	if H then H.Clear(player) end
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if o then P.Destroy(o); Delivery.orders[player.UserId] = nil end
	Delivery.requests[player.UserId] = nil
	Delivery.Publish(player, code or "Cancelled")
end
function Delivery.RemovePlayer(player)
	if H then H.Clear(player) end
	local o = Delivery.orders[player.UserId]
	if o then P.Destroy(o); Delivery.orders[player.UserId] = nil end
	Delivery.requests[player.UserId] = nil
	E.Leave(player)
end
return Delivery
